tbesh_html:
Azmaveth = "strong unto death"
a place in Benjamin;
Another name of bet az.ma.vet (בֵּית־עַזְמָ֫וֶת "Beth-azmaveth" H1041)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: from H5794 (עַז) and H4194 (מָוֶת); strong one of death;
